business_problem: As Dr.Job scaled its operations, several infrastructure and operational challenges emerged: Fragmented systems across multiple providers, leading to inefficiencies Increasing API traffic and job data volume causing latency and bottlenecks
solution_summary: Dr.Job used Alibaba Cloud to address As Dr.Job scaled its operations, several infrastructure and operational challenges emerged: Fragmented systems across multiple providers, leading to inefficiencies Increasing API traffic and job data volume causing latency and bottlenecks. Dr.Job is an AI-powered recruitment platform that connects employers, publishers, and job seekers through a unified job distribution ecosystem. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Dr.Job serves a growing global market across the UAE, GCC, MENA, and international regions. Dr.Job selected Alibaba Cloud based on: Global infrastructure with strong regional coverage High-performance cloud-native services for large-scale systems Dr.Job migrated to a unified cloud-native architecture on Alibaba Cloud to support high-scale recruitment operations.
